title: Your game starts with your idea
summary: Write the game description in your own words. We’ll use it to ask useful questions, research relevant examples and prepare a plan you can change and approve.
scope: No game has been designed yet. This page shows how your description, choices and progress will stay together throughout development.

decisions.label: Where would you like people to play?
decisions.rationale: Nothing has been chosen. You can give a preference now or decide after we understand your game.

options.label: I haven’t decided
options.impact: After reading your description, we can explain the options that suit it.

options.label: In a web browser
options.impact: The plan will consider the screens and controls people use to open your game.

options.label: A computer app
options.impact: The plan will consider installation and the computers you want to support.

options.label: On a phone or tablet
options.impact: The plan will consider touch controls, small screens and how people get the game.

next_steps.title: Start with your game description
next_steps.detail: You write what you want to make. We keep your wording and ask you about anything important that is missing.

next_steps.title: Settle the practical choices
next_steps.detail: Together we consider who will play, where it will run, difficulty and the size of the first version. Any AI recommendation is clearly labelled.

next_steps.title: Review the plan before building
next_steps.detail: We add relevant research examples, proposed work and ways to check it. You can change the choices and approve a revised plan before building begins.

acceptance: Your description is kept in your own words. Missing details become questions for you.
Practical recommendations fit your description and the people you want to play.
You can understand and change the plan, and nothing is built before you approve it.
boundaries: This is an empty review template, not a proposed game or permission to build.
The AI does not write, expand or rewrite your game description.
Publishing a game or spending money needs a separate agreement.
open_questions: Your game description is still needed.

development.summary: We are waiting for your idea. No game-specific choices, reference research or building have begun.
development.next: Write your description above, then prepare a reply and return it in chat.

milestones.title: Receive your description
milestones.detail: Your own account of the game you want to create.

milestones.title: Prepare a plan with you
milestones.detail: Ask focused questions and explain the practical recommendations that follow from your description.

development.change_note: A blank template ready for the user's own game description.
